def process_graph(graph_data):
    graph_copy = graph_data.copy()

    target_name = "ju1.s4.s1c3"
    new_node_name = "new_EK_PORT_4"

    target_node = None
    for n, attrs in graph_copy.nodes(data=True):
        if attrs.get("name") == target_name and "EK_PACKET_SWITCH" in attrs.get("type", []):
            target_node = n
            break

    if target_node is not None:
        new_node = new_node_name
        suffix = 1
        while new_node in graph_copy:
            new_node = f"{new_node_name}_{suffix}"
            suffix += 1

        graph_copy.add_node(new_node, name=new_node_name, type=["EK_PORT"])
        graph_copy.add_edge(target_node, new_node, type="RK_CONTAINS")

    graph_json = nx.readwrite.json_graph.node_link_data(graph_copy)
    return_object = {
        "type": "graph",
        "data": graph_json,
        "updated_graph": graph_json
    }
    return return_object
